Leave a short set of drying instructions near the Ashby tumble dryer so guests can use it safely and confidently. Include reminders to clean the lint filter after every load, check clothing care labels, avoid overloading, keep the area around the dryer clear, stay in the property while it runs, and allow the programme—including the cooling stage—to finish. [P1]

The passages give conflicting warranty periods: P1 says the Fenwick cooker hood has a two-year warranty from the purchase date, while P2 says it is covered for 66 months from the delivery date. [P1] [P2]

For an Ashby tumble dryer with a flashing warning light, stop the programme, switch it off, unplug it, and let it cool. Clean and securely refit the fluff filter; empty and reseat the water tank if fitted; and make sure no clothes are trapped in the door before closing it firmly. [P1]

Reconnect it and select the programme again. If the light continues flashing, stop using the dryer and contact Halvard Home support, stating which light is flashing and when it appears. [P1]

If a cooking-zone light is flashing, check that an induction-compatible pan is centred on the selected zone and that its base is clean and dry; switch the zone off before repositioning or replacing the pan. [P1] If it continues, turn the hob off, let it cool, and wipe moisture from the control area before trying again. [P1]

If the stovetop displays a fault message or error code, stop cooking and switch the hob off using its controls. [P2] Ensure the control area is clean, dry, and clear of cloths, utensils, or spills. [P2] You can reset it by switching it off at the safely accessible wall isolator for 60 seconds, then restoring power. [P2]

If the error persists or returns, leave/stop using the hob and contact Halvard Home support; note the exact message or flashing light and when it occurs. [P1] [P2] Do not remove the glass or attempt internal repairs. [P2]

Use a heating schedule to set the time you want heating to begin, rather than setting a number of minutes to wait. For example, to delay heating by one hour from 18:00, set the start time to 19:00, choose the target temperature, save the schedule, and ensure it is enabled for the correct day. [P1]

Heating will start at that time only if the room is cooler than the target temperature. [P1]
Keep the extractor running for 10 minutes after cooking to clear lingering steam and smells. [P1] [P2] [P3]

Stop using the dryer immediately. Switch it off and unplug it from the wall socket if it is safe to do so, and do not run another cycle or restart it to test whether the smell has cleared. [P1] [P2]

If there is smoke or flame, keep the door closed, leave the property, and call 999; do not use water or try to move the appliance. [P1]

If there is no fire, leave it unplugged until it has cooled completely. You may then remove fluff from the lint filter and check that external air vents are clear. [P1]

Do not use the dryer again until it has been checked by a qualified appliance technician. [P1]

If you spot frost or ice inside the dishwasher, do not start a programme. Switch it off and contact Halvard Home support for advice before using it again. Do not use boiling water or a sharp tool to remove the ice, as this may damage surfaces and seals. [P1]

If your Fenwick extractor/cooker hood screen is blank, first check that its wall switch or fused spur is on, then test the light and fan controls to establish whether only the display or the whole appliance is affected. [P1]

Switch the hood off at its electrical supply for 60 seconds, then switch it back on and try the controls again; keep your hands dry when using electrical switches. [P1]

If the fan and light work but the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support and tell them which controls still respond. [P1] If nothing works, check whether other kitchen appliances have power, and arrange a qualified inspection if the issue continues. Do not remove covers or touch internal wiring. [P1]

Hire a suitably qualified heat pump installer to disconnect, move, recommission and check the Orrin heat pump at its new location. [P1] The installer should confirm that the new position, connections, drainage and electrical supply meet the installation instructions before it returns to use. [P2]

To relocate an Ashby tumble dryer safely:

- Switch it off, unplug it from the wall socket, and let it cool completely if it has been running. [P1]  
- Remove all laundry, clean the lint filter, empty the water tank if fitted, and disconnect any external drain or vent hose. Secure hoses and the power cable so they cannot drag, catch, or be damaged. [P1]  
- Plan a clear route, removing obstacles such as trailing leads and loose rugs; keep children and pets away. [P2]  
- Use two people and suitable appliance-handling equipment. Do not lift it by the door, control panel, lead, or fittings. [P1] [P2]  
- Keep the dryer upright, protect its cabinet, secure the door and loose connections, and secure it against movement in transport. [P1] [P2]  
- At the new location, put it indoors on a firm, level floor, with ventilation unobstructed. Keep it at least 113 cm from a gas hob or open flame, and within 297 cm of an accessible suitable socket. [P2]  
- After moving it, leave it disconnected and wait 38 hours before switching it on. Before reconnecting, inspect the plug, lead, casing, and connections for damage and confirm that it is stable and has clear airflow. [P2]  
- Reconnect drainage or venting as instructed, and plug it directly into a suitable earthed wall socket without an extension lead or adaptor. [P2] [P5]

On its display, open **Settings > Software update > Check for updates**. Select **Install** if an update is available and follow the on-screen directions. Keep the dryer powered on and do not start a drying programme until the display confirms installation is complete. [P2]

To use spoken commands with your Mira floor-cleaning robot, first make sure it is online in the Halvard Home app and that you can start a clean from the app. [P1] In your voice assistant’s app, add a smart-home device, search for and select **Halvard Home**, then sign in using the same Halvard Home account used for Mira and allow access. [P1] Ask the assistant to discover devices, give the robot a simple name such as “Mira,” and say, “Start Mira.” [P1] If it does not appear, check its internet connection, unlink Halvard Home in the assistant app, and link it again. [P1]

Send Halvard Home customer support your cooktop’s full model details, a clear photo of the part you need (if you still have it), and a short description of the required part; if it is missing, describe its purpose instead. [P1]  

For a service repair, also describe what happens when you use the hob, including any display message, and provide photos of visible damage where relevant. [P3]

To relocate a built-in Corra induction hob safely:

- Switch it off and allow the cooking surface to cool before moving it. [P1]  
- Have a qualified electrician isolate and disconnect any fixed or hardwired electrical connection; do not cut, pull, disconnect, or alter the wiring yourself. [P1] [P2]  
- Remove cookware and loose items, clear the carrying route, and protect the glass from knocks. [P1] [P2]  
- Have the installer release any fixings or seals; do not lift the hob while it is still secured to the worktop. [P2]  
- Use suitable assistance—P2 specifies two people—and lift by the body/approved handling points, not by the cable, controls, glass edges, or exposed glass. [P1] [P2]  
- Do not tilt the hob more than 54 degrees while carrying it. [P1]  
- Transport it in protective packaging, ideally the original packaging, with cushioning and no objects placed on the glass. [P1] [P2]  
- After moving it, wait 17 hours before switching it on. [P1]  
- Before reuse, have a qualified installer check and reinstall it, confirming stability, ventilation, cable routing, and electrical safety at the new location. [P1] [P2]  
- Keep it disconnected and contact Halvard Home if it was dropped, struck, exposed to water, moved beyond the tilt limit, or shows cracked glass, smoke, a burning smell, or unusual electrical behaviour. [P1]

If you are keeping food in the refrigerator, leave it switched on, set the fridge to 4°C and freezer to −18°C, make sure both doors close properly, and remove food that will expire before you return. [P1]

If you will empty it for the months you are away, switch it off and unplug it before cleaning. Remove all food, let ice thaw, clean the interior with warm water and mild detergent, dry it thoroughly, and leave both doors ajar to prevent odours and mould. [P1]

To prepare the Keel washing machine for a safe move:

- Switch it off at the socket, unplug it, turn off the water supply, and disconnect the inlet hose; keep a towel and shallow tray ready for remaining water. [P1]
- Drain all water using the user-manual instructions, empty the drum, and leave it dry. [P1]
- Refit the original transit bolts/transport restraints as instructed, because they secure internal parts during transport. If they are missing, contact Halvard Home before moving or arranging transport. [P1] [P2]
- Secure the door, hoses and cable so they cannot swing, trail, become trapped or stretch. [P2]
- Keep the washer upright where possible, do not tilt it more than 59 degrees, and use suitable lifting equipment and assistance—do not carry it alone. [P2]
- Do not lift or pull it by the door, detergent drawer, controls, hoses or power cable. [P2]
- Plan and clear the moving route, protect flooring without creating a slip hazard, and keep children and pets away. [P2]
- At the new house, leave it upright in its intended position with the electricity disconnected for 44 hours before switching it on. Remove the transport restraints before operating it. [P2]

Use the Mira robot vacuum’s child lock: while the vacuum is switched on and stationary, press and hold the power button for 3 seconds. Wait for the confirmation sound that indicates the lock is active. [P1]  

The child lock prevents use of the buttons on the vacuum, helping stop a toddler from starting cleaning or changing settings. [P1] However, scheduled cleaning and Halvard Home app controls still work, so it may still start automatically; keep children away while it is moving. [P1]

To return your Mira robot vacuum to its original setup, place it on its plugged-in charging dock, then press and hold the **Power** and **Home** buttons together for 10 seconds. Release them when you hear the reset announcement, and leave the vacuum on the dock while it restarts. [P1]

This factory reset clears saved Wi‑Fi details, cleaning schedules, and maps. After restarting, add the vacuum again in the Halvard Home app and reconnect it to Wi‑Fi. [P1]

To remove chalky limescale safely, switch off and unplug the kettle, let it cool completely, and empty any water left inside. Lift it off the base and dry the outside. Check whether water has run down from the spout or lid, and make sure it has not been filled above the MAX mark. [P1]
